title: Austin Civil Service Appointments & Plans
meeting_type: Audit and Finance Committee Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   **Key Appointments Made for Civil Service Commission:** Erica Cane was appointed and Pamela Lancaster reappointed as Chair of the Municipal Civil Service Commission.
*   **Exploring New Appointment System:** The committee announced plans to investigate creating an "alternate system" for future commission appointments.
*   **Thanks to Dedicated Applicants:** All candidates for the demanding commission were thanked and encouraged to continue their civic involvement.
